description_en:
Your most important piece of equipment. Used for all core FrackinUniverse functions.
Use to access the following features:
Primary: Check Status
Secondary: Quest Menu
Shift: Configure MM Settings
description_zh:
你最最重要的随身装备。为所有FrackinUniverse核心功能所用。
左键：检查状态
右键：任务菜单
Shift+左键：物质枪设置
